units.source_text: 这个天真的恶作剧，最终成了一把自动锁：

en.t: This innocent prank eventually became an automatic lock:

units.source_text: 只有丈夫一个人能打开的装有防盗装置的自动锁。

en.t: an automatic lock fitted with an anti-theft device that only her husband could open.

units.source_text: 很难说没有人会去注意那封信。

en.t: It was hard to say that no one would notice that letter.

units.source_text: 那简直像故意留下表示自己逃亡意志的声明书。

en.t: It was almost like deliberately leaving behind a declaration of her intent to run away.

units.source_text: 已经有人看见你在现场，

en.t: Someone had already seen you at the scene,

units.source_text: 你要是仔细地擦去指纹，反倒会成为犯罪的证据。

en.t: and if you carefully wiped away your fingerprints, that would instead become evidence of a crime.

units.source_text: 这不是和愚蠢犯人的行径如出一辙吗？

en.t: Would that not be exactly the same as the behavior of a foolish criminal?
